section4_gapfill_threats.threat: Elevation of privilege via missing centralized authorization layer, making the next endpoint added the same way as transactions/beneficiaries just as likely to omit its ownership filter
section4_gapfill_threats.surface: Authenticated API routes (users/wallets/transfers/beneficiaries/transactions), Object-reference & mass-assignment boundary
section4_gapfill_threats.asset: Transaction/transfer ledger, Beneficiary PII, User credentials & PII

section4_gapfill_threats.threat: Tampering with transaction-ledger history via direct database access going undetected, since balances are a mutable running total with no append-only journal or checksum chain independent of the wallet row
Future dependency drift (like the jsonwebtoken downgrade) shipping unnoticed due to absence of automated dependency/CI security scanning

section4_remaining_threats.threat: Information disclosure of internal implementation details via verbose error responses
section4_remaining_threats.asset: Underlying Postgres database, User credentials & PII

section4_remaining_threats.threat: Clickjacking and reduced defense-in-depth via missing security headers
section4_remaining_threats.controls: helmet used; CSP gated to production only, unverified any production deployment exists

section4_remaining_threats.threat: Lateral access to the dev database via hardcoded, over-privileged credentials committed to a tracked setup script

section5_deprioritized.reason: pino-http request logging plus AuditLog business-event logging already cover the actors that exist today (single account holder per session, no shared/admin accounts yet)

section5_deprioritized.threat: Adjacent-network / physical MITM threats (ARP spoofing, rogue Wi-Fi)
section5_deprioritized.reason: out of scope - local dev-only deployment today, no network topology to model

section5_deprioritized.threat: Cloud/insider threats to hosting infrastructure (IAM over-grant, lateral SA assumption)
section5_deprioritized.reason: asset not present - no Terraform/k8s/cloud IaC exists in this repo yet

section5_deprioritized.threat: Resource-exhaustion DoS via untrusted file/media parsing
section5_deprioritized.reason: asset not present - app has no file-upload or media-parsing entry point
